tagline: North America's premier value-added metals processor
hero_kpi_rationale: Major operational pillar representing the largest source of value-added for Worthington Steel, with a leading independent position in North America in carbon flat-rolled steel processing

kpis.name: Global manufacturing footprint
kpis.explanation: Operational network of 28 manufacturing facilities (pre-Sitem acquisition) located in the United States, Canada, China, India, Germany, and Mexico
kpis.description: 28 strategically positioned manufacturing facilities, with 19 in the United States, 2 in Canada, 4 in Mexico, plus facilities in China, India, and Germany. After Sitem acquisition in June 2025: 5 additional facilities in Italy, France, and Slovakia
kpis.signal: Competitive advantage through geographic proximity to customers

kpis.name: Customer base
kpis.explanation: Diversified portfolio of customers serving the automotive, construction, machinery, agriculture, and heavy truck industries
kpis.description: Approximately 1,200 customers served in fiscal 2025 across multiple end markets including automotive, construction, machinery and equipment, agriculture, and heavy trucks. Top 3 customers represent 33% of net sales
kpis.signal: Diversified customer base reducing risk concentration

risks.title: Economic or industrial downturn
risks.score_rationale: 52% exposure to the automotive market and 11% to construction. A decline in these markets would have a major negative impact on financial results and cash flows

risks.title: Steel price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Volatile steel prices directly impact raw material costs and operating margins

risks.title: Climate and environmental regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Increasing environmental regulations impact production costs and reputation. The steel industry is exposed to decarbonization requirements

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on multiple suppliers of raw steel coils in North America. Logistics disruptions or supplier issues could affect operations

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: Fragmented market with numerous competitors. Price, quality, and delivery competition exert pressure on margins

risks.title: Customer concentration
risks.score_rationale: Top 3 customers represent 33% of net sales. Loss of a major customer would have a significant impact

risks.title: Tariff and geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: International operations and exposure to tariffs. Geopolitical tensions could impact costs and margins

ai_positioning.summary: Worthington Steel has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar terms in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing. The company focuses on operational optimization through the Worthington Business System, a strategic framework for continuous improvement using tools and technology, but without explicit reference to AI
evidence: Worthington Business System: a strategic framework designed to drive continuous improvement through the use of enabling tools and technology
